stemMd: Which limitation most directly prevents the class from claiming that every enzyme in every species is inactivated by the same heating treatment?

options.label: B
options.textMd: Only one type of extract and one heating treatment were examined

options.label: C
options.textMd: All assays had the same peroxide concentration.

explanationMd: The evidence concerns this extract under one heating procedure. A universal claim about all enzymes and species exceeds that scope.

distractorRationale.d: Those units do not limit the range of species sampled.
distractorRationale.c: This control improves treatment comparison rather than establishing universality.
distractorRationale.a: Replication does not make the biological sample universal.
